name: Facet
text: Choose a light theme as the default for Excava’s interface. It maximizes visibility for daytime use and aligns with the Manus Competitive Analysis, where dark themes dominate but light themes perform better for data-heavy tasks. The trade-off is slightly reduced "liveliness" in low-light settings, but we’ll address that with auto-switching based on ambient light. This keeps the interface clear and enjoyable for the majority of users right away.

name: Pane
text: Light themes fail in mixed lighting—glare from windows or screens forces users to squint or adjust angles, slowing them down. Auto-switching flickers in those conditions, so users will toggle manually anyway, defeating the default. Settle it with a live glare test: measure task completion time in a room with mixed lighting, comparing light default vs. dark default with manual override.
